title: Mike Macdonald on ownership change: "We're entering a new chapter in our organization's history"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike Macdonald on ownership change: "We're entering a new chapter in our organization's history"
sources.description: The Seahawks opened training camp on Saturday, only two weeks after the organization announced that the team would be sold to a group led by Vinod Khosla, pending league approval.
